evidence.observation: Stable monotonic temperature profile with slow gradual rise (~1 K over 20 min), consistent column gradient from 80 to 67 °C
Reflux and distillate flows steady near 0.41-0.43 L/h
System pressure steady ~598 mbar, pressure drops steady ~0.8/2.0 mbar
Reboiler reading ~495 °C, implausible for this system — likely sensor scaling/offset issue, but otherwise stable

args.missing_evidence: A composition measurement (GC/analysis) of distillate and bottoms; also verification of T701 calibration/units.
